mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two skids was worthwhile: each separate fitting visibly added support, which became clear when the whale stood upright.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated flips were straightforward but less engaging in the text interface, although they clearly exposed the appropriate sides.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: the guided assembly was clear and satisfying, but these mostly explicit fittings left little for me to decide. The text trial cannot tell me how the pictures or physical handling would feel.
